events.title: 리버풀 win the League Cup for the seventh time in their history thanks to a 2–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the final at Millennium Stadium in Cardiff . On the same day, 아스널 establish an eight-point lead at the top of the league and look all set for a second successive league title.
맨체스터 유나이티드 cut 아스널's Premier League lead to five points with a 2–1 home win over struggling 리즈 유나이티드.
Mexican club Guadalajara appoints Hans Westerhof as their new technical director.

Howard Wilkinson is sacked as 선덜랜드 manager (along with his assistant Steve Cotterill) after his team won just two out of 20 Premiership matches under his management. The hunt for his successor begins, with Mick McCarthy, David O'Leary and George Burley the three names being particularly strongly linked with the vacancy.
선덜랜드 appoint former Republic of Ireland national coach Mick McCarthy as their new manager.
아스널 are now just two points ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the league, after they lose 2–0 at 블랙번 로버스 and their rivals win 1–0 at 애스턴 빌라.
Two goals in three minutes for Forest sets them on their way to a 3–0 victory over 더비 카운티.

리즈 유나이티드 , 16th in the FA Premier League and £120million in debt, sack Terry Venables after eight months in charge. Peter Reid is named as his successor on a temporary contract until the end of the season, but it is far from clear whether Reid will get the job on a permanent basis.
아스널 return to the top of the Premier League with a narrow 2–1 win over 에버턴.
Manager Mike Snoei is fired by Dutch club 피테서 to Ajax , and replaced by former player Edward Sturing .

March draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now leading the Premier League just a month after 아스널 looked to have won it, though 아르센 벵거 's team are only a point behind with a game in hand . Three points now separate 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 at the top of Division One. 셰필드 유나이티드, Reading, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 remain in the play-off zone. 입스위치 타운's resurgence has seen them creep to the fringe of the top six, but 로더럼 유나이티드's playoff hopes are evaporating.
